technology_name: P-11 — S. aureus phage K immobilized on electrospun Ti-coated catheter surface
one_line_proposition: Technology: S. aureus phage K immobilized on electrospun Ti-coated catheter surface. Problem: Infection = 8-12% of shunt failures, $40-80K per case. Antibiotic resistance emerging..
target_application: Infection = 8-12% of shunt failures, $40-80K per case. Antibiotic resistance emerging.
why_you_may_care: A computationally specified P-11 concept plus a preregistered decisive experiment — not a validated technology.

current_evidence.evidence_summary: See evidence ledger — 1 evidence atoms across 6 tiers

what_is_not_proven: NO_FAILURES_TESTED_YET — all evidence is MODELLED. Buyer should treat all claims as untested hypotheses until decisive experiment is commissioned.
decisive_question: Phage stability on Ti in CSF. Biofilm prevention in realistic challenge.
if_pass: Advance to next development phase (see Development Plan)
what_we_are_asking_you_to_do: COMMISSION TEST — coat Ti catheters with phage K, challenge with S. aureus, measure biofilm
